no single test or combination of tests is currently able to diagnose all candidaemia cases.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Candida blood-culture and mannan-Ag plus anti-mannan-Ab detection is a good combination, especially with lower cutoffs.
the best indirect diagnostic test for candidaemia is a combined mannan-A/Ab test, with lower cut-off values.
a combination of blood culture and mannan-Ag/anti-mannan Ab is a good strategy for diagnosing candidaemia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, despite the introduction of new diagnostics, candidaemia detection remains difficult and requires a combination of clinical and para-clinical data, and a combination of diagnostic tools.
a combined approach using both direct (blood culture) and indirect (mannan-Ag and/or Ab) tests is the most effective strategy for diagnosing candidaemia.
